rounds.hypothesis: Meter M6 after review F09-F15: boundary funding follows the minute's triggers; funding coverage is derived from the data (every 2020-01..2026-08 monthly file, stamps within 1 s of the 8-hour grid); flat cash is valued at each FX change; FX is labelled an ex-post valuation; results bind source, inputs, funding ledger and daily equity; partial runs never overwrite evidence; research knobs are restored. rounds.outcome: Every M6 account has the same final value, fees, funding and MDD as its M5 counterpart. No boundary funding followed a stop inside its minute, and no position was held across an uncovered funding time.

rounds.hypothesis: Meter M7 after the 7c9b2b7 re-audit (R1-R5) and the additional findings of the same round. Measurement rules are unchanged; only the shared production decision chain changed: an owned IOC fill is protected on a short path with snapshot reuse, fill adoption needs trade-ID/flat-boundary proof, risk-reducing unknown intents block only new risk and are retired on a verified flat account, margin history is attributed one row to one transfer, documented 503 failures and never-accepted missing orders are terminal. Reads are zero-latency in this meter and the write order is unchanged, so identical accounts are expected. Parameters unchanged.
rounds.outcome: The expected identity did not hold. Fewer reads per entry leave more of the local 2200/min request-weight reserve, so top-up previews that M6 refused for capacity now run: 28 of 795 sessions differ, 23 only in preview counts and 5 in top-up fills (first: 2023-10-17, order 164 adds on an earlier poll with a larger print-bounded fill). P7 CNY 5228630, CAGR 153.86%, MDD envelope 44.73% (P6 5230718, 153.87%, 44.73%); both targets met on the base; fee, slippage and depth stresses stay below 150%. Not an out-of-sample proof; native execution not verified.
